scope: Actual TypeScript geometry, HeroScene anchor evaluation, and TransitionLayer paint math executed in Node with minimal inert DOM-shaped objects. No browser, no WebGL visual/compositing claim.

actual HeroScene emits positive dimensions and exact CSS source corners
hidden source remains sampleable at the identical quad
HeroScene respects the shared tablet/mobile layout classification at 720 px

A settles within 2 px of both warped destination quads

B preserves source and destination exact quads at adjacent boundaries
fixed frame A seek is independent of traversal history
completed handoffs remove every bridge subtree from rendering
reverse entry restores only the two active A bridges
disabled handoffs suppress explicitly visible cloned descendants
